_comment: Named onnx-mlir flag sets. ${TARGET_CPU} must be supplied explicitly (compile_shape.py --target-cpu or SHAPEPERF_TARGET_CPU) and is recorded; 'native' is refused unless --allow-native (spec §5.4 step 6). Source facts at v0.5.1.1 (src/Compiler/CompilerPasses.cpp:69, src/Dialect/Mlir/VectorMachineSupport.cpp): krnl-level SIMD on x86 is enabled only for --march=x86-64 (SSE4.2 machine model, 128-bit, FP32 VL=4); any other --march value (including 'native' or unset) selects NoVectorMachineSupport. To be confirmed at G0 from actual --opt-report=Simd output, not assumed.

default.purpose: main single-thread configuration (spec §5.3) - candidate, to be confirmed at G0

default_parallel.purpose: multi-thread extension (spec §5.3); reported separately from single-thread results

O3_nosimd.purpose: diagnostic alternative for answer table B (spec §9.3): documented flag, SIMD off

O0.purpose: correctness/diagnostic path only; not assumed to be a competitive alternative (spec §9.3)

probe._comment: Probe stage candidate (spec §8.2b): ONNX->Krnl->Affine, where the opt-report is printed. Whether this stage determines all §6.2 features, and the probe/final mismatch rate, are G3 measurements.
